title: [Main]Incorrect Cost Amount (Actual) in Value Entries after posting Assembly Process and calulating the assembly standard costsInitial commit
summary: Fixes wrong Cost Amount (Actual) in value entries for assembly orders after Calc. Assembly Std. Cost. For assembly orders, the inventory adjustment now recalculates overhead from the cost shares and re-rounds it, so per-unit and per-output indirect costs match.
key_points: Root cause: per-unit and per-output indirect costs were rounded inconsistently after the standard cost was recalculated with high precision
For assembly orders, overhead is recomputed after the if/else in codeunit 5896, whichever branch ran
Costs are rounded, then indirect cost and unit cost are recalculated
A test was added to SCMCalculateAssemblyCost
quote: Incorrect Cost Amount (Actual) in Value Entries after posting Assembly Process and calulating the assembly standard costs
